capabilities: Sync notes, attachments and selected settings across devices
Encrypt notes and attachments on the device before upload
Encrypt whole notes or selected text with passwords
Restore note versions, deleted content and sync conflicts
Sort, pin, search and reopen local files
extras: Free plan includes 100 MB; paid annual plans add storage. Also includes an EPUB reader for DRM-free EPUB 2/3 files up to 48 MiB. README notes no independent third-party security audit.
problem: Obsidian users in China need to keep notes and attachments consistent across devices while storing encrypted content in commercial cloud storage.

relations.evidence: 已通过 BRAT 安装的用户

summary: Sync plugin that synchronizes notes, attachments and selected settings across devices with client-side encryption and commercial cloud storage.
